'''''Totally Patriotic''''' was an album by [[Red Shift Limit/Legends|Red Shift Limit]], and a parody of [[The Emperor's New Clothes]] [[Totally Patriotic (The Emperor's New Clothes album)|album of the same name]]. It was banned by the [[Imperial Board of Culture]].
